description: Versioned inventory and discovery-profile composition for the China financial regulatory source catalogs. Profiles select catalogs for discovery only; applicability still requires evidence-backed facts and reviewed rules.

packs.description: Cross-sector laws, governance, AML, privacy, data, cyber and common financial regulation.
Banking prudential and lending sources plus several bank-and-insurance shared instruments.
Insurance solvency, funds, products, sales, reinsurance, reserves and fraud sources.
Payment, financial data, outbound transfer, cybersecurity, cryptography, cloud and public-AI sources.

profiles.description: Cross-sector discovery foundation; never a complete entity profile by itself.
Bank discovery union, including cross-sector data, cyber, cloud and AI sources.
Insurance discovery union; the banking pack is included because it currently contains shared licence, related-party, consumer and reporting instruments.
Technology-provider discovery union; payment obligations still require the relevant licence and activity facts.
Non-bank payment discovery union, subject to payment licence, business and reserve-fund facts.
